name: Moire Wipe
description: Two sets of fine concentric rings drift toward each other over the picture and interfere into wide moire bands, which open onto the second clip and widen until it fills the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: density
params.description: Number of rings per frame height in each set

params.name: bands
params.description: How many moire bands the rings make at the start

params.name: drift
params.description: How far the two centers turn around each other, in turns

params.name: lines
params.description: Strength of the ring lines drawn over the picture
